queue.description: Document the machine-readable export format so an unfamiliar developer knows what /api/export returns.

patch.new:
## What remains manual / what automation would need

See REPORT.md.

## Export format

`GET /api/export` returns `{"exports": [...]}`. Each export separates
four sections: `human_statements` (submitted comment, approved draft),
`automated_checks` (classification, rationale, flags, references used),
`test_outcomes` (challenge records), and `human_approvals` (explicit
timestamped decisions). Machine readers must never treat
automated_checks as a verdict: `is_verdict` is always false.
